scoring_justification: Full recompute of the VicCA simulation is infeasible within the verifier sandbox. We compare the reported scaling exponents and morphology classification to reference values (tolerance-based for scaling, exact for morphology).

outputs.description: Time-scaling exponents (1/z and β) from VicCA simulations. Compared to hidden reference values within a tolerance.
Morphology classification diagram. Each cell's morphology string is compared exactly to a hidden reference classification.

output_contract.notes: The scaling exponent artifact is scored with tolerance-based reference matching with tolerance 0.10. The morphology diagram uses exact string comparison against a hidden reference. Both artifacts require the preceding VicCA simulation (process step) to have been completed.
